documents.title: Internal Security Audit — Q2 2024
documents.content: Role-based access controls are enforced at the tool layer. Basic users may search only public web sources; admin users may additionally search this confidential collection. Vendor contracts and internal system architecture are stored in proprietary vault C. Admin classification: internal-security-audit-2024.
